garments.name: 버건디 울 베레모

garments.name: 레드 방울 비니

garments.name: 허쉬컷
garments.brief: Short layered hush cut for a chibi character in T pose, soft feathery layers framing the face and falling just past the chin, light airy volume at the crown, wispy see-through bangs above the eyebrows, ash brown. Closed rounded crown with hair-coloured root backing, rear roots connected down to the nape, clear face opening with readable eyebrows, a few broad smooth clumps, no loose strands.
